notes_for_editor: Thin. Sourced: county, agency and location code (Forest Lookouts page), gone status (lookout list), a mapped point and elevation (TopoQuest; Mapcarta for the town). Mapcarta is crowd-sourced from OSM and GeoNames and is used only for the town name, the community's unincorporated status and its relative position. No build date, builder, staffing, removal date or site condition found. The location code 37N-12E-12 is quoted, not converted. Record elevation 548 m matches TopoQuest 1797 ft. The central record's 'federal' ownership is not quoted on any page read, so no ownership fact is recorded and access is not stated. Not used: WHS record HI24439 (Franklin Lake Campground caretaker's cabin, National Forest Rd 2181, Hiles township), a different building. Suggested checks: Forest County Historical Society; Laona Ranger District records; Nicolet National Forest history (npshistory.com, chapter 7, found in search and not read).
